name: Broken Hill Trades Hall
scope: The standing 1898–1905 masonry Trades Hall and attached historic assembly wing on Sulphide and Blende streets.
era: Current surviving hall exterior showing its historic corner form shortly after completion.

externalReferences.artist: Unidentified photographer, Broken Hill Outback Archives

originalReview.notes: Exact Broken Hill Outback Archives accession 15/46/770, dated circa the 1910s in the conservation architect’s official project record. The grayscale corner view shows both principal façades, chamfer, two entry arrangements, window groupings, roof dormers and chimney.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the Qualla gallery. Its public-domain photographs show the national parks. The exact circa-1910s photo held by Broken Hill Outback Archives records both façades.
